abstract: Monitors banquet seating capacities, concession licensing, and attendee VIP hospitality suites
system_message:
You are the Hospitality and catering director (HCD), monitoring banquet seating capacities, concession licensing, attendee VIP hospitality suites, and commercial catering refrigeration operations across prospective convention facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors banquet seating capacities, concession licensing, and attendee VIP hospitality suites（HOSP）
information_points.content:
HCD-HOSP-PPX：For Prater Park Exhibition Pavilion, the formal banquet hall banquet seating capacity in the primary gala ballroom set for round-table dining provides 1100 seats.
HCD-HOSP-1QL：For Belvedere Grand Conference Hall, the formal banquet hall banquet seating capacity across the primary gala ballroom in a round-table dinner configuration is 850 seats.
HCD-HOSP-V64：For Danube Waterfront Congress Center, the formal banquet hall banquet seating capacity in the primary gala ballroom configured for round-table dining is 600 seats.

information_points.title: Commercial catering refrigeration（KITCH）
information_points.content:
HCD-KITCH-SXF：At Danube Waterfront Congress Center, the main central banquet kitchen features a walk-in cold room gross volume of 85 m3 across its operational chilled units.
HCD-KITCH-Z3Z：At Prater Park Exhibition Pavilion, the combined operational chilled units in the main central banquet kitchen offer a walk-in cold room gross volume of 45 m3.
HCD-KITCH-NKM：At Belvedere Grand Conference Hall, the walk-in cold room gross volume across the main central banquet kitchen cold storage totals 65 m3.
